definitions.explanation: Any living entity, including animals, plants, and microorganisms.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦には→には：noentry⟧⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧{生物|せいぶつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There are various organisms in the ocean.

examples.japanese: {生物|せいぶつ}⟦{多様性|たようせい}→多様性：04825_tayousei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}ること→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{微|び}{生物|せいぶつ}→微生物：12665_biseibutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}えない→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: Microorganisms cannot be seen with the naked eye.

notes:
{生物|せいぶつ} is the scientific or formal term for living things, encompassing animals, plants, and microorganisms. A compound of {生|せい} (life) + {物|ぶつ} (thing).

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{生物|せいぶつ}{学|がく}→生物学：07107_seibutsugaku⟧: biology
- ⟦{微|び}{生物|せいぶつ}→微生物：12665_biseibutsu⟧: microorganism
- {生物|せいぶつ}⟦{多様性|たようせい}→多様性：04825_tayousei⟧: biodiversity
- ⟦{海洋|かいよう}→海洋：00143_kaiyou⟧{生物|せいぶつ}: marine life
- {生物|せいぶつ}⟦{兵器|へいき}→兵器：11679_heiki⟧: biological weapon

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {生物|せいぶつ}: living thing (scientific, includes all organisms)
- ⟦{生|い}き{物|もの}→生き物：01783_ikimono⟧: living thing (everyday speech, often refers to animals)
- ⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧: animal (excludes plants)

USAGE:
Also read as なまもの, meaning raw or uncooked food. Context makes the reading clear.
